meta.title: Blue Carbon Finance for Pacific Fisheries
meta.tagline: Feasibility assessment for a blended finance facility supporting coastal communities

blocks.text: A blended finance facility can mobilise private capital for community fisheries if concessional funding absorbs the first losses.

items.label: Private capital mobilised per USD of concessional funding
Coastal communities in the first phase

blocks.text: The facility would lend to community fisheries cooperatives against verified blue carbon outcomes. The structure has three tiers: a first-loss grant tranche, a concessional debt tranche and a commercial senior tranche. Each tier has a clear owner and a defined return.

blocks.title: Key message
blocks.text: Capital is not the binding constraint. Coordination, bankability and verification are.

Pacific coastal ecosystems store large quantities of carbon, but most community-led conservation is funded by short grants. Investors lack a standard way to price the risk, and communities lack the technical capacity to prepare bankable projects.

items: **Fragmented funding:** many small grants, none large enough to finance infrastructure.
**No shared standard:** verification methods differ between donors and registries.
**Limited local capacity:** project preparation is slow and costly.

rows: Lowers the blended cost of capital
blocks.caption: Indicative capital structure.

blocks.text: A steering committee of funders and community representatives approves each project. The facility manager reports to the committee every quarter^[Reporting follows the agreed template and covers financial and verified carbon outcomes.].
The real failure is one of coordination, bankability and structuring capacity.

rows: Local currency tranche with a partial guarantee
Technical assistance window for project preparation
blocks.caption: Principal risks and how the structure addresses them.

blocks.title: Fisheries cooperative, Fiji
blocks.body: A cooperative of 140 members restored 220 hectares of mangrove and sold verified credits to a regional buyer. Revenue funded cold storage, which cut post-harvest losses.

items: Agree the first-loss commitment with development partners.
Confirm the verification standard with the registry.
